correctness.rationale: Every arc-subset and simplicial coboundary of the fixed eight-cycle is exactly enumerated. Verified face vector (16,96,272,384,272,96,16), ranks of coboundary maps 191 and 190, and 3x3 rotation columns (7,4,1) with rank(A-I)=2. The published free integral H3 and H6 groups, together with direct Lefschetz fixed-face counts and top orientation, force the rational sign plus Gaussian decomposition. Algebraically, every split integral sign-plus-quarter-turn lattice would have mod-two fixed dimension two, contradicting the computed one. No finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: This naturally cyclic eight-vertex complex has highly connected lower homology and its first nontrivial three-dimensional rotation lattice has a rational sign/Gaussian decomposition. The exact mod-two Jordan block detects intrinsic integral gluing invisible to all rational character values or Betti ranks, a concrete structural obstruction relevant to integral-equivariant multipath classification. The claim is restricted to the exact motivated eight-cycle; it does not assert a universal phenomenon.
